title: OKR Framework Guide
content:
OKR Framework Guide

Objectives and Key Results (OKR) is a goal-setting framework used by teams to define measurable goals and track outcomes. This guide covers:

1. Setting Objectives: Clear, ambitious, and time-bound.
2. Defining Key Results: Measurable milestones per objective.
3. Tracking Progress: Weekly check-ins and quarterly reviews.
4. Best Practices: Alignment, transparency, and stretch goals.
